content: The speaker explains that the time an algorithm takes to run depends on the number of elements it processes. To analyze this, they **parameterize runtime as a function of input size**. They emphasize that **upper bounds on running time are crucial** because they provide a valuable **guarantee to the user**. Knowing an algorithm will *not exceed* a certain time (e.g., "no more than 3 seconds") is much more useful than knowing it will take *at least* a certain time (e.g., "at least 3 seconds"), as the latter offers no meaningful assurance about its maximum duration.
